api.github.com publishes no robots.txt: checked by hand on 2026-11-27, one plain GET of
https://api.github.com/robots.txt, it answered HTTP 404 with GitHub's JSON "Not Found":

{
  "message": "Not Found",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest",
  "status": "404"
}

No rules, so nothing there is closed: neither /repos/Danielhp95/caracole/releases/tags/models (the release listed),
/repos/Danielhp95/caracole/releases/assets/<id> (its asset) nor /repos/jayg996/BTC-ISMIR19/git/blobs/<sha> (BTC's
authors' file), which the phone's chord models' download asks (core.models.ModelsSource), as the site catalogues'
asks the release indexes (core.catalogues). github.com's own robots.txt, which closes /*/releases/download/, is for
github.com alone: the phone never asks that host.
